lawn.title: The lawn
lawn.description: The turf as a whole. Where it is, what it sits on, what grows on it and how it was made; then, in the next two steps, what waters it and what the weather over it is read from. Each zone is added afterwards, with its own size, aspect and valve.

data_description.location: Used for the sun's path and the climate zone. Defaults to your home.
data_description.soil_type: Squeeze a damp handful: sand falls apart, clay ribbons, loam holds and crumbles.
data_description.grass_type: Pick the closest match. A seed mix for temperate climates is a cool-season mix.
data_description.establishment_method: Sod roots in weeks and seed in a season, so the first year's care differs.
data_description.establishment_date: Leave empty if the lawn is older than a couple of years.

irrigation.title: Irrigation
irrigation.description: How water gets onto the grass. Hosekeeper converts minutes to millimetres with this, so advice can be given in the unit your timer understands.

data_description.flow_l_min: Litres per minute for the whole field. Read it from the water meter during a run, or add up the nozzles.
data_description.precipitation_rate_mm_h: If you have measured it with catch cups, this wins over the flow rate.

sources.title: Weather and sensors
sources.description: The forecast is required. Everything else is optional and, when present, replaces the forecast's estimate with what was measured.

data.robot_cadence: How often the robot goes out

data_description.rain_sensor: A daily total that resets at midnight, or an ever-increasing total. Both are fine.
data_description.solar_sensor: With humidity and wind this enables the full FAO-56 evapotranspiration model.
data_description.mower_entity: Each mowing session is logged as a mow.
data_description.deck_min_mm: Optional, both together: the range on the mower's dial or deck. Advice is kept inside it, so a robot that stops at 60 mm is never asked for 75.
data_description.robot_cadence: Every pass has the lawn occupied and goes over the same ground, so a gentler cadence leaves it alone between cuts. Ignored where there is no robot.

error.flow_required: Enter a flow rate or a precipitation rate, or choose no irrigation system.
error.duplicate_source: The same entity is selected twice. Each sensor can feed one measurement only.
error.deck_reversed: The lowest cut is above the highest one.

abort.already_configured: A lawn with this name is already set up.

options.frequent: Every day the season asks for, as the machine schedules it
options.balanced: Often enough to keep the clippings short
options.gentle: As seldom as the grass allows

state.irrigation_due_soon: Irrigation due in a couple of days

dose_g_m2.name: Dose
dose_g_m2.description: Grams per square metre. Defaults to the middle of the label rate.

log_sowing.description: Record seeding, overseeding or a repair.

replace_today.description: Set the day's total rather than adding to it. Use it to correct a figure.

set_status.name: Set lawn condition
set_status.description: Record how the lawn looks, which the engine uses to adapt watering and feeding.

zone_id.description: The zone it applies to, published by the activity sensor as zone_id.

import_weather.name: Import weather
import_weather.description: Enter one day that has already happened, as it was measured, so a lawn set up today has the season behind it. Apply the days oldest first: each one carries in the balance the day before it left behind.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone it applies to, published by the activity sensor as zone_id.

rain_mm.name: Rain
rain_mm.description: What fell that day, in mm.

humidity_pct.name: Mean humidity
humidity_pct.description: Optional. With humidity, wind and radiation the day is worked out by Penman-Monteith rather than from the temperatures alone.

solar_mj.name: Solar radiation
solar_mj.description: Optional, MJ per m² over the day.

unknown_field.message: No Hosekeeper lawn matches the entry {entry}.

zone.title: The zone
zone.description: One part of the lawn, with its own valve. Its area and how much sun it gets decide how much water it needs and when it is best cut.

data_description.exposure: Full sun is six or more hours of direct light in summer.
data_description.valve_entity: Optional. Run time is logged automatically while it is on.

features.title: Shade
features.description: Trees and structures that shade part of this zone. Shade cuts water use but favours moss and disease, and trees compete for water and drop leaves. Leave everything at none if the zone is in the open.

data.feature_0_shade: Share of zone shaded by feature 1
data.feature_1_shade: Share of zone shaded by feature 2
data.feature_2_shade: Share of zone shaded by feature 3

data_description.feature_0_shade: How much of the zone sits in its shade for a good part of the day.

error.too_much_shade: Shade shares add up to more than 90 % of the zone.
